caveat: The default-real-overflow fault specifically assumes wp is wider than default REAL (the repository default is wp=c_double and ordinary WRF REAL is single precision). A nonstandard build with RTE_USE_SP or default-real promotion should either skip that specific cast-overflow expectation or use a build-kind-aware assertion. This does not affect the production checks, which inspect each declared kind.

source_behavior_review.arithmetic_note: The added checks evaluate finiteness only; expressions passed to checkers (e.g. heat*86400 and fd-fdir) do not write into model/RRTMGP state.
source_behavior_review.assessment: No successful-path arithmetic or array assignments are added/changed; checks scan existing result arrays and call existing require/fatal path only for nonfinite values.
source_behavior_review.coverage: LW clear/all-sky fluxes and heating are checked in wp before conversion and default REAL after conversion. SW clear/all-sky fluxes, heating, direct/band outputs and returned diagnostics are checked. SW optional pre-delta g-point/band and default-real diagnostics are checked when requested; night early return checks initialized zero outputs, including optional outputs.
source_behavior_review.diagnostics: First offending column and interface/layer are included with phase, stage, field, optional band index and precision. Checks are performed immediately after RTE/heating output creation or default-real conversion.
source_behavior_review.precision_separation: The helpers accept explicit REAL(wp) and default REAL arrays separately, and diagnostics identify precision=wp or precision=default-real. WP defaults to iso_c_binding c_double in mo_rte_kind; ordinary WRF default REAL remains its declared default kind.

test_review.existing_driver_coverage: test_columns now checks clear/all-sky outputs, repeats, overlap modes, daylight and night including SW diagnostic partitions. test_sw_predelta_direct checks standard and optional pre-delta output arrays for baseline, predelta and night.
test_review.fault_injections: Generator makes isolated source copies from exact production anchors and refuses if call-site counts drift. Three faults inject LW clear flux NaN, SW all-sky heating NaN and a wp-finite value that overflows on conversion to default REAL. The executable only passes if the injected failure is detected; CTest requires the exact phase/stage/field/column/index/precision marker plus nonzero exit.
test_review.test_limits: This is a source review only. No build, test, model or RTE execution was performed by the reviewer. Root-owned focused build/tests remain the runtime validation.
